goal: Fix the HUD flash/glitch when tapping a playing video to reveal controls.
goal_source: interactive query from human (not from backlog)
last_actions: 2026-11-23: Diagnosed the glitch: in onTouchUp the tap branch read uiRef.current AFTER onTouchDown's wakeControls() had set controlsVisible=true, so a tap that revealed the chrome scheduled setControlsVisible(false) 300ms later. The HUD flashed then vanished; touching the HUD itself skipped the gesture path (data-cbp-ui) so it stayed.

Fix: added uiAtDown ref capturing uiRef.current on pointer-down before wakeControls(); the tap branch now uses that pre-tap state to decide show vs hide, with no delayed hide timer. Double-tap zone seek and mouse click/dblclick untouched.
blockers: No local tsc; Vercel cloud build authoritative (build passed).
next: Await confirmation that tapping a playing video now reveals a stable HUD.
